description: Native material definitions: the stat bonuses a workshop result made of the material gains. The original records' class, affinity and base-DP values are not columns: no game code reads them (items carry their own ratings and DP), so catalogs/items/import/materials.json keeps them with the reserved bytes.

columns.name: display_name
columns.description: Informational plain-text label; not a key or gameplay value.

columns.name: legacy_id
columns.description: Compatibility kind for existing inventory, saves and palettes; not a definition field-width limit.

columns.name: strength
columns.description: Added to a workshop result's base strength when it is made of this material.

columns.name: intelligence
columns.description: Added to a workshop result's base intelligence when it is made of this material.

columns.name: agility
columns.description: Added to a workshop result's base agility when it is made of this material.
